ACT No. XX of 1947
[31st March, 1947]
An Act to give effect to the financial proposals of the Central
Government for the year beginning on the 1st day of April, 1947.
WHEREAS it is expedient to
discontinue the duty on salt manu factured in or imported into, [Subs. by the Central Laws (Statute Reform) Ordinance, 1960
(21 of 1960), s. 3 and 2nd Sch. (with effect from the 14th October, 1955), for
the Provinces and the Capital of the Federation" which had been subs. by
A.O., 1949; for "British India".] [Pakistan], to fix maximum
rates of postage under the Post Office Act, 1898, to continue, subject to
certain modifications, for a further period of one year the additional duties

enacted as follows: --‑
